items.title: L3Harris Stock Jumps on Earnings Beat. The Defense Business Is Growing.
items.summary: The defense contractor reported second-quarter earnings per share of $3.13. Wall Street was looking for $2.80.

items.title: General Dynamics Stock Drops Following Earnings Beat
items.summary: General Dynamics  has managed to avoid much of the defense stock pain that came after fighting began in Iran.  Wall Street was looking for earnings per share of $3.96 from sales of $13.5 billion.  Orders were higher than sales, a good omen for future revenue growth.

items.title: Here’s What Rising Defense Spending Means for Northrop Grumman (NOC)
items.summary: Northrop Grumman Corp (NYSE:NOC)’s leadership in military aviation received another boost after the U.S. Navy awarded the company a $1.2 billion contract. The award reinforces the company’s growing backlog and highlights why rising global defense spending continues to strengthen its long-term investment case. items.title: Reading Between The Lines Of RTX's Latest Call

items.title: Boeing's Q2 Loss Wider Than Estimated, Revenues Increase Y/Y
items.summary: BA's Q2 revenues beat estimates and backlog hits a record $715.3 billion, but a wider-than-expected adjusted loss tempered the stronger sales performance.
